jobs.title: Manager of IT / Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

One80 Intermediaries
is seeking a Manager of IT / Senior Project Manager
to join our growing team!

We’re seeking a Manager of IT / Senior Project Manager to lead the information technology strategy for one of our divisions within Arrowhead Intermediaries while overseeing the planning, execution, and delivery of IT-related projects. This role ensures that technology goals align with business objectives, manages IT teams and drives project success from initiation through completion.

How You Will Contribute:

Conduct thorough problem analysis regarding technical systems and application programs; document findings and propose problem resolution alternatives.
Develop and implement IT strategies that support company goals and enhance operational efficiency.
Lead, mentor, and manage IT teams, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple complex IT projects, ensuring adherence to scope, timeline, and budget.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define project requirements, goals and deliverables.
Ensure compliance with IT policies, standards, and best practices including security protocols.
Collaborate with network staff to ensure smooth and reliable operation of software and systems for fulfilling business objectives and processes.
Work at the highest level of all technical phases of programming; requires a high degree of creative thinking and the ability to use the accumulated knowledge and experience of others.
Design and develop procedures, both manual and automated, to solve business opportunities.
Highly self-motivated and directed, with keen attention to detail.

Skills & Experience To Be Successful

B.S. in Information Technology or related field; master’s degree preferred.
5+ years experience in IT leadership and managing IT coding projects.
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies and tools.
Experience with the full life cycle of software development.
Experience with document management, vendor management, and website management.
Experience managing a team, with a track record of setting goals, delegating effectively, and developing team members' skills.
Excellent communication skills at all levels, teamwork, leadership, and independent motivation.
Proven analytical and creative problem-solving abilities.
Certification such as PMP, ITIL or similar are a plus.

About One80

One80 Intermediaries is part of Arrowhead Intermediaries, a global insurance distribution platform that offers deep specialization, scale, and innovation across wholesale brokerage, program administration, and specialty insurance. With more than 7,000 professionals worldwide and a collective portfolio exceeding $18 billion in premium placed in 2024, our combined organization delivers a diverse trading platform for insurance carriers as well as expanded access and niche solutions for brokers and customers navigating complex and hard-to-place risks. The platform combines entrepreneurial culture with operational excellence to deliver tailored solutions and long-term value across the insurance ecosystem.

Pay Range

$100,000 - $120,000 Annual

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:

Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement
Mental Health & Wellness: Free Mental Health & Enhanced Advocacy Services
Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

Not reflective of all benefits. Enrollment waiting periods or eligibility criteria may apply to certain benefits. Benefit details and offerings may vary for subsidiary entities or in specific geographic locations.

Recruiting Vendor Disclosure Statement

Brown & Brown does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiters, recruitment vendors or employment agencies ("Recruiting Vendors"). Recruiting Vendors must have a valid written agreement and received prior written authorization from an authorized Brown & Brown representative before submitting candidates for any publicly posted role. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Brown & Brown or its employees become the property of Brown & Brown, and no fees will be paid for such submissions. Additional information regarding this policy can be found on our careers page.

The Power To Be Yourself

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment comprised of people from all backgrounds, with a variety of experiences and perspectives, guided by our Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging (DIB) motto, “The Power to Be Yourself”.

jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The hiring organization is seeking a Director, IT Operations for a full-time role based in the United States. This leader will oversee global infrastructure, IT service delivery, security and compliance operations, and AI-driven operational initiatives within a healthcare SaaS environment.

Responsibilities

Lead a team of 10+ global resources responsible for help desk services, facility management, SOC policy enforcement, and asset management.
Design and oversee infrastructure architecture to support 99.5%+ uptime across a healthcare SaaS environment.
Deliver help desk services that maintain a 95% SLA within established response and resolution frameworks.
Co-own incident management, escalation protocols, and post-incident review practices.
Manage infrastructure spend and cloud resource optimization across AWS, GCP, or multi-cloud environments.
Drive technical standardization across development, security, and product teams.
Identify, evaluate, and implement AI/ML tools for operational efficiency, including predictive alerting, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experiment with AI-driven automation for routine operational tasks and cultivate a culture of predictive observability.
Partner with the organization's AI Program to explore IT operations transformation and operationalize AI initiatives.
Collaborate with the VP of Enterprise Technology to define operational requirements, observability, and alerting standards for AI model deployment, monitoring, and governance at scale.
Develop operational runbooks and playbooks that support safe, rapid experimentation.
Partner with Security to ensure operational practices align with SOC 2, HIPAA, and state healthcare compliance requirements.
Manage access control, secrets management, least-privilege architectures, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
Direct quarterly compliance audits and remediation workflows.
Establish and govern SLAs and SLOs for critical services, lead capacity planning, and direct the infrastructure roadmap.
Foster an operational culture grounded in blameless postmortems and continuous improvement.
Communicate infrastructure health, operational risks, and roadmap priorities to leadership and cross-functional teams.
Support product and engineering teams with infrastructure provisioning and technical troubleshooting.
Manage vendor and cloud provider relationships while mentoring and developing operational staff.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of experience in IT operations, infrastructure engineering, or site reliability engineering roles.
5+ years of experience in a leadership role managing technical teams, including at least 5 direct reports.
Demonstrated experience operating mission-critical SaaS or healthcare platforms.
Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code practices.
Strong understanding of HIPAA compliance, security baselines, and healthcare regulations.
Proven track record of designing systems for 99.5%+ uptime and managing production incidents.
Experience establishing operational cultures focused on automation, blameless postmortems, and on-call excellence.
Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and establish operational processes from scratch within a fast-growing organization.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building and scaling IT organizations within early-stage or hypergrowth companies.
Hands-on experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, along with modern DevOps toolchains.
Professional background in healthcare environments, including EMR/EHR systems or telehealth platforms.
Experience supporting machine learning or AI infrastructure at scale.
Familiarity with database operations, replication strategies, and backup and recovery management.
Knowledge of healthcare data architecture and data privacy requirements.
Prior experience in startup environments or professional consulting.
Experience evaluating or implementing AI/ML operational tooling, such as predictive alerting or AIOps platforms.
Proven track record of applying AI to enhance operational efficiency or organizational decision-making.

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Flexible spending and health savings accounts
Flexible paid time off

jobs.title: Director of Technology (Remote from anywhere in CO).
jobs.description:
Department Information

Together, we innovate for a stronger Colorado

The work of employees at the Governor's Office of Information Technology (OIT) is challenging and diverse because the needs of agencies, customers and Coloradans constantly evolve. But our focus never changes: improve the lives of all Coloradans through innovation and collaboration. We're building one of the nation's leading government IT organizations by reimagining how we support agencies, building first-of-their-kind applications, and creating an inclusive, collaborative culture, together. Join us in the important work of providing equitable access to services.

Watch this video to learn more about how we're Serving People. Serving Colorado.

Description Of Job

IMPORTANT NOTE:

Please review your application to ensure completion. For the most equitable applicant experience, OIT’s hiring team considers only the contents of your application to review your qualifications. Please do not include any attachments (such as resume or cover letter) with your application as these items are not used by OIT’s hiring team.

The Colorado Governor's Office of Information Technology is in the middle of a transformation worth joining. We're building cross-functional pod teams that partner directly with agencies to design, deliver, and continuously improve services that work for Coloradans. Good government depends on technology that works. And OIT exists to make that true for every Coloradan. The State of Colorado is seeking a Director, Technology to help build the next generation of public services. We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers in service of the public.

The Director, Technology is the Leader in OIT’s agency service model. You will determine the appropriate approach in working with OIT and Agency executives in aligning and implementing OIT and agency business needs. This position operates proactively as a strategic partner, embedding in agency planning before problems surface, rather than reactively as a service provider. You will build credibility with agency leadership quickly and maintain it through demonstrated delivery. The role oversees technology used to support all aspects of any supported agency's technology needs and collaborates with agency leadership as a strategic partner to provide in-depth technical expertise in support of business decisions.

What You'll Do...

Communicate and translate between technology initiatives and mission requirements with senior agency stakeholders, including Executive Director, CFO, and program leads.
Facilitate discussions with agency stakeholders and operational staff to identify competing priorities and elicit clear decisions.
Develop and maintain a living technology roadmap that is focused on agency priorities, which can be shifted to meet changing needs.
Oversee advisory teams as a matrixed leader coordinating agency technology portfolios.
Monitor vendor contract performance in terms of agreed outcomes and escalate failure to deliver on standards.
Identify, assess, and communicate technology risk effectively to non-technical agency leaders.
Understand and align OIT services with customer expectations to achieve high satisfaction.
Develop outcome-based performance agreements with agency stakeholders that define success in terms of mission impact and constituent benefit, not system availability or ticket volume.
Drive compliance with enterprise architecture standards (EA), while maintaining focus on agency missions and program needs; flag exceptions and engage OIT’s EA function.
Implement user centricity, agile, product ownership, modular procurement, and continuous delivery at conceptual and operational levels.
Work with cross-functional teams at agency and OIT to efficiently navigate State governance and procurement laws, considering factors such as SOO vs SOW, as well as T&M Structures.
Develop, drive, and hold staff accountable to team expectations tied to outcomes rather than activity metrics.
Conduct regular 1:1s and performance conversations that are developmental and coaching-oriented, which provide direct, honest feedback and accountability to team members. Build an environment where team members surface problems early rather than hiding them.
Provide proactive intervention to mitigate issues arising from workload, skill-gaps, etc., that are not dependent upon performance review cycles.
Conduct human resource management activities such as developing performance plans, and approving performance reviews; oversee disciplinary/corrective, and separation actions.
Coordinate with the OIT HR team to drive recruitment and selection processes that consider user-centered outcomes, and candidate experience.

What You Bring...

Ability to speak credibly to an agency's Executive Director, CFO, and program leads, to translate between technology and mission. This includes the ability to identify, assess and communicate technology risks to non-technical audiences.
Ability to navigate complex political dynamics, while maintaining focus on outcomes.
Ability to influence agency program staff and political leadership through collaboration and complex relationship management.
Ability to develop and maintain a multi-year roadmap that aligns technology investment to mission priorities
Ability to manage budget and resources, and influence thinking in regards to technology investment.
Ability to set individual and team performance expectations tied to outcomes, conduct developmental performance conversations, and navigate performance issues constructively across a cross-functional team of specialists.
Ability to manage across disciplines — providing meaningful feedback and accountability to team members — without needing to be a practitioner in each craft.
Ability to quickly understand state agency planning, budget, and decision-making processes, including budget cycles, legislative constraints, and executive branch governance
Knowledge of enterprise architecture fundamentals sufficient to apply EA standards, flag exceptions, and engage meaningfully with OIT's EA function
Ability to apply modern software delivery approaches, including user centricity, agile, product ownership, modular procurement, and continuous delivery at a conceptual and operational level
Knowledge of State IT governance, procurement law, and vendor contracting in a government context.

Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions Of Employment & Appeal Rights

A wide salary range is posted for this position and any job offer is based upon a salary analysis to comply with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. The salary analysis considers relevant experience, education, certifications, and state seniority as compared to others doing substantially similar work. While all offers are compliant with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, there is no guarantee an offer will be at the top of the posted range based on the salary analysis.

Minimum Qualifications

This is a skills-based job announcement. The required minimum qualifications and/or education (if substituting for the proven experience, knowledge, and skills), are as follows:

A minimum of eight (8) years of experience as a lead in the delivery of technology solutions, to include three (3) years experience managing cross-functional teams using iterative, user-centered methods.
A track record of working across disciplines — design, engineering, policy, or operations — to ship things that work for real people.

Substitutions

Additional appropriate education will substitute for the required experience on a year-for-year basis, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.

Training or Certification related to the work assigned to the position will be assigned credit towards substitution for experience and/or education, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.

If the minimum qualifications include a degree requirement, additional appropriate paid or unpaid experience will substitute for the required education on a year-for-year basis.

Preferred Qualifications

Relevant certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Institute Product Management, PMP, or Professional Product Manager (PPM).
Experience working within a digital service agency or a government-adjacent technology firm, successfully translating mission-driven policy goals into actionable product backlogs.
Experience in modern procurement practices is highly desirable, with the ability to structure vendor requirements in a way that remains outcome-oriented and agile rather than locking the state into rigid, fixed-scope contracts
Background in User-Centered Design (UCD).

Conditions Of Employment

OIT employees must comply with any screening procedures in place at state agency locations where they might perform work.

A pre-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process. Post-employment background checks will be required for specific agencies as business needs dictate, which may include a polygraph exam, fingerprint-based criminal history search, reference checks, and a drug test.

This position may require travel within the specified geographic area, and to locations across the state as needed.

Supplemental Information

If this posting indicates “remote from anywhere in CO” in the title, periodic reporting to the primary state work location designated for the position is required. All remote work must be performed in Colorado.

While candidates from out of state will be considered for this role, the candidate selected for the position must relocate and reside in Colorado on the first day of their new position. A reasonable timeframe for relocation will be established on an individual basis, while considering business needs, and determining a start date.

If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation to ensure you have a positive experience applying or interviewing for this position, please direct your inquiries to our ADA Coordinator at OIT_HR@state.co.us or call (303) 764-7900.

jobs.title: Vice President of Solutions Engineering and Technology
jobs.description:
At Goldschmitt and Associates LLC (G&A), we’re not just another company—we’re a catalyst for innovation and impact, and we’re inviting passionate, forward-thinking individuals to join us on this journey. Recognized multiple times on the Inc 5000 list of the fastest-growing companies, G&A is a leader in tech transformation and system modernization for some of the nation’s most important federal agencies.

Our culture is built on creativity and collaboration. We offer flexible schedules, telework options, and an environment where your ideas truly matter. At G&A, you won’t just clock in—you’ll be solving real-world challenges and working on projects that make a difference in the lives of millions.

Joining our team means becoming part of a vibrant, connected community where innovation thrives, your voice is heard, and your impact is felt. Whether you’re a tech enthusiast, a strategic thinker, or a problem-solver, at G&A, you’ll have the opportunity to level up your career while making a real-world impact.

If you’re ready to be part of a company that values purpose as much as progress, G&A is the place for you!

Summary:

Goldschmitt and Associates is seeking a Vice President of Solutions Engineering and Technology to provide senior technical leadership across our federal programs, customer initiatives, and commercial software products.

This role leads the development of technology solutions for complex business, operational, and mission challenges. The Vice President works directly with customers, program leaders, product teams, technical architects, engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, evaluate existing environments, design future-state solutions, and guide initiatives from concept through implementation.

The position combines executive-level technical leadership with hands-on solution engineering. The successful candidate must be able to move comfortably between customer conversations, business processes, system workflows, application and integration design, cloud architecture, security considerations, and implementation planning.

This is broader than a traditional cloud architecture or DevOps role. The Vice President will evaluate how people, processes, applications, data, infrastructure, security requirements, and external systems work together and develop practical solutions that can be successfully implemented and operated in complex enterprise and federal environments.

The position supports both Goldschmitt technology initiatives and billable customer engagements, including modernization efforts, external-facing portals, secure-system integrations, workflow design, cloud solutions, enterprise integrations, technical discovery, and complex cross-system initiatives.

This position is part-time and remote, and the anticipated hourly rate is $125.00 per hour.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Solutions Engineering and Technical Leadership

Lead solution engineering for complex customer, product, and enterprise technology initiatives
Translate business, mission, and operational challenges into practical technical solutions and implementation approaches
Provide senior technical leadership from initial discovery and concept development through design, implementation, deployment, and operational transition
Evaluate existing systems, processes, architectures, workflows, and technical constraints and develop appropriate future-state solutions
Develop and communicate solution concepts that span applications, cloud infrastructure, data, APIs, cybersecurity, integrations, workflows, and user experience
Evaluate technical alternatives and make recommendations based on security, scalability, maintainability, performance, reliability, cost, usability, and operational requirements
Identify technical risks, dependencies, constraints, and integration challenges early and develop approaches to address them
Provide technical leadership during complex implementations and help resolve issues that cross organizational, system, or technology boundaries
Establish and promote effective solution engineering practices, reusable approaches, and technical standards
Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers, architects, developers, DevOps personnel, and other technical team members

Customer Technical Consulting

Serve as a senior customer-facing technical leader and trusted consultant for Goldschmitt customers and partners
Lead technical discovery sessions, design workshops, solution-development sessions, architecture discussions, and technical reviews
Work with customer stakeholders to understand mission objectives, operational processes, user needs, system limitations, security requirements, and future-state goals
Translate customer needs into technical requirements, solution designs, workflows, integration strategies, and implementation plans
Facilitate discussions among business users, government stakeholders, system owners, cybersecurity teams, architects, developers, infrastructure teams, and other technical participants
Develop and present architecture diagrams, workflows, solution concepts, technical roadmaps, integration approaches, and implementation recommendations
Help customers identify opportunities for modernization, automation, improved workflow, system integration, and operational efficiency
Communicate complex technical concepts and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences
Support customer presentations, demonstrations, proposals, statements of work, technical estimates, and solution development for new and existing programs

Workflow, Integration, and Secure-System Solutions

Analyze complex operational processes and design future-state business and system workflows
Design solutions that connect users, applications, processes, data, and systems across organizational and technical boundaries
Lead solution design for external-facing portals and applications that interact with secure or restricted enterprise environments
Define secure approaches for exchanging information between externally accessible applications and protected internal systems
Design system boundaries, data flows, integration points, authentication approaches, authorization models, APIs, interfaces, and supporting workflows
Develop solutions for integrating modern applications with legacy, externally managed, or highly controlled systems
Identify opportunities to replace manual processes with secure automation while accounting for operational and security requirements
Collaborate with system owners and cybersecurity teams to develop practical approaches for moving data and transactions across security boundaries
Design technical approaches that account for both system functionality and the real-world workflow of the people using the solution

Federal Program and BOP Support

Provide senior technical consulting and solution engineering support to Goldschmitt federal customers, including the Federal Bureau of Prisons
Support the design and evolution of external portals and applications that interface with systems operating within secure federal environments
Lead discovery and workflow-design activities with customer stakeholders to understand operational processes and translate them into effective technical solutions
Define integration approaches between external-facing systems and internal applications, services, databases, APIs, and data exchanges
Support modernization, automation, and workflow-improvement initiatives involving existing federal systems
Facilitate technical working sessions involving customer stakeholders, program personnel, system owners, cybersecurity personnel, architects, engineers, and developers
Develop technical documentation and solution artifacts needed to support customer decision-making, security review, development, implementation, and operations
Provide senior technical problem-solving support for complex issues involving multiple applications, environments, organizations, or technical disciplines

Cloud and Platform Engineering

Provide senior-level leadership for cloud strategy and AWS solution design supporting enterprise and SaaS applications
Design secure, scalable, resilient, highly available, and cost-effective cloud solutions
Support AWS Commercial and AWS GovCloud environments
Guide cloud architecture decisions involving networking, compute, containers, storage, databases, application services, identity, monitoring, and security
Design and support containerized application environments and modern cloud deployment architectures
Develop and maintain AWS Infrastructure as Code
Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes
Support production, staging, development, testing, demonstration, and other application environments
Design approaches for multi-environment, multi-customer, and tenant-based SaaS deployments
Design and implement automated environment and tenant provisioning capabilities
Review significant infrastructure and application changes for scalability, security, reliability, operational impact, and architectural fit
Monitor cloud environments for availability, performance, security, capacity, reliability, and cost
Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, deployment, integration, configuration, and availability issues when senior technical support is required

Application and Product Collaboration

Collaborate closely with Goldschmitt's Director of Technical Architecture, product leadership, and development teams on application and platform initiatives
Translate customer and product requirements into solution-level designs that can be implemented by application development teams
Participate in application design decisions involving APIs, integrations, authentication, authorization, data flows, workflow, infrastructure, and external services
Work with technical architecture and development leadership to ensure solution designs are practical, maintainable, secure, and aligned with established product architecture
Support integration between Goldschmitt applications and customer, partner, commercial, legacy, and federal systems
Provide solution-level guidance while partnering with technical architecture and development leadership responsible for detailed application architecture and backend implementation
Help bridge the gap between customer requirements, product strategy, solution architecture, cloud infrastructure, and software engineering

Security, Identity, and Compliance

Incorporate cybersecurity and compliance requirements into solution design from the beginning of an initiative
Design and oversee application authentication, authorization, identity-management, and access-control approaches
Implement and manage AWS identity, roles, policies, permissions, and access controls following least-privilege principles
Work with cybersecurity and compliance teams to identify application, cloud, and integration changes necessary to meet applicable federal security requirements
Support FedRAMP, ATO, NIST 800-53, FISMA, and other applicable federal cybersecurity and compliance initiatives
Support security architecture, system-boundary definition, logging, monitoring, auditability, and security-control implementation
Evaluate solution designs for security risks and recommend practical mitigation approaches
Implement and maintain cloud and application monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and operational dashboards
Support backup, recovery, resiliency, continuity, and disaster recovery planning

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

Significant experience in senior technical leadership, engineering leadership, enterprise technology, architecture, or technical consulting roles
Demonstrated experience leading complex technical initiatives involving multiple systems, applications, technical disciplines, and stakeholder groups
Strong experience translating business and operational requirements into technical strategies, workflows, solution architectures, and impleme

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Salesforce:

We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.

About The Role:

We are seeking a technically adept and innovative Agent Builder Leader to join our Forward Deployed Engineering Team. You will lead a high performing Agent Builder expert team to deliver Agentic solutions directly with customers. Your primary responsibility will be to provide strategic and technical leadership, fostering innovation and cultivate a culture focused on continuous improvement. As a key member of the Agentforce leadership team, you will define the standards, and operating model that allow Agentic AI capabilities, directly influencing the product roadmap for agentic adoption across our customer base.

Your Impact:

Strategic Leadership: Define the long-term strategy for Agentic AI deployments across industries.
Drive Multi-Agent Intelligence: Establish best practices and reference architectures for Model Context Protocol (MCP), inter-agent communication, and AI orchestration within multi-agent systems.
Own Agentic Development Life Cycle (ADLC): Standardize ADLC across all the engagements. Oversee project delivery and ensure the deployed agents meet customer needs while scaling robustly in enterprise production environments.
Internal and External Thought Leadership: Evangelize Salesforce’s agentic architecture vision internally and with strategic customers, industry partners, and ecosystem developers.
Operational Excellence: Build a high-performing team capable of delivering enterprise-ready, production-grade agentic systems.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Sales leadership to shape the strategy and execution of Agentic AI solutions.
Governance and Security Stewardship: Oversee policies for data privacy, and compliance. Partner with internal security and legal teams to enforce responsible AI practices globally.

Required Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in building and scaling enterprise-grade applications or enterprise AI systems, including 5+ years in leadership roles overseeing technical teams.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to influence and engage executive stakeholders on complex technical roadmaps with both technical and non-technical teams.
Expertise in AI implementations, including RAG, vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases, specifically for grounding Agentforce solutions with enterprise data.
Expert-level knowledge of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous processing principles.
Current, comprehensive knowledge of the LLM landscape, including the specifications, capabilities, and ideal use cases for major foundational and frontier models relevant to enterprise AI deployment, along with the tooling ecosystem.
Deep understanding of how AI agents operate within enterprise ecosystems, including the principles of multi-agent orchestration, data-driven decisioning, and autonomous action design.
Ability to think strategically while remaining technically credible with Product, Engineering and Architecture teams.
Ability to travel 30% of the time, as needed to customer sites.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting data or integration solutions using MuleSoft, or Einstein GenAI Agentforce or similar platform.
Industry thought leader in the convergence of AI, and enterprise integrations.
Prior experience leading multi-disciplinary teams in fast-scaling or global enterprise environments.
Track record of production-ready deployments in secure, regulated enterprise environments.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. new_jobs.description:
Department Information

Together, we innovate for a stronger Colorado

The work of employees at the Governor's Office of Information Technology (OIT) is challenging and diverse because the needs of agencies, customers and Coloradans constantly evolve. But our focus never changes: improve the lives of all Coloradans through innovation and collaboration. We're building one of the nation's leading government IT organizations by reimagining how we support agencies, building first-of-their-kind applications, and creating an inclusive, collaborative culture, together. Join us in the important work of providing equitable access to services.

Watch this video to learn more about how we're Serving People. Serving Colorado.

Description Of Job

IMPORTANT NOTE:

Please review your application to ensure completion. For the most equitable applicant experience, OIT’s hiring team considers only the contents of your application to review your qualifications. Please do not include any attachments (such as resume or cover letter) with your application as these items are not used by OIT’s hiring team.

The Colorado Governor's Office of Information Technology is in the middle of a transformation worth joining. We're building cross-functional pod teams that partner directly with agencies to design, deliver, and continuously improve services that work for Coloradans. Good government depends on technology that works. And OIT exists to make that true for every Coloradan. The State of Colorado is seeking a Director, Technology to help build the next generation of public services. We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers in service of the public.

The Director, Technology is the Leader in OIT’s agency service model. You will determine the appropriate approach in working with OIT and Agency executives in aligning and implementing OIT and agency business needs. This position operates proactively as a strategic partner, embedding in agency planning before problems surface, rather than reactively as a service provider. You will build credibility with agency leadership quickly and maintain it through demonstrated delivery. The role oversees technology used to support all aspects of any supported agency's technology needs and collaborates with agency leadership as a strategic partner to provide in-depth technical expertise in support of business decisions.

What You'll Do...

Communicate and translate between technology initiatives and mission requirements with senior agency stakeholders, including Executive Director, CFO, and program leads.
Facilitate discussions with agency stakeholders and operational staff to identify competing priorities and elicit clear decisions.
Develop and maintain a living technology roadmap that is focused on agency priorities, which can be shifted to meet changing needs.
Oversee advisory teams as a matrixed leader coordinating agency technology portfolios.
Monitor vendor contract performance in terms of agreed outcomes and escalate failure to deliver on standards.
Identify, assess, and communicate technology risk effectively to non-technical agency leaders.
Understand and align OIT services with customer expectations to achieve high satisfaction.
Develop outcome-based performance agreements with agency stakeholders that define success in terms of mission impact and constituent benefit, not system availability or ticket volume.
Drive compliance with enterprise architecture standards (EA), while maintaining focus on agency missions and program needs; flag exceptions and engage OIT’s EA function.
Implement user centricity, agile, product ownership, modular procurement, and continuous delivery at conceptual and operational levels.
Work with cross-functional teams at agency and OIT to efficiently navigate State governance and procurement laws, considering factors such as SOO vs SOW, as well as T&M Structures.
Develop, drive, and hold staff accountable to team expectations tied to outcomes rather than activity metrics.
Conduct regular 1:1s and performance conversations that are developmental and coaching-oriented, which provide direct, honest feedback and accountability to team members. Build an environment where team members surface problems early rather than hiding them.
Provide proactive intervention to mitigate issues arising from workload, skill-gaps, etc., that are not dependent upon performance review cycles.
Conduct human resource management activities such as developing performance plans, and approving performance reviews; oversee disciplinary/corrective, and separation actions.
Coordinate with the OIT HR team to drive recruitment and selection processes that consider user-centered outcomes, and candidate experience.

What You Bring...

Ability to speak credibly to an agency's Executive Director, CFO, and program leads, to translate between technology and mission. This includes the ability to identify, assess and communicate technology risks to non-technical audiences.
Ability to navigate complex political dynamics, while maintaining focus on outcomes.
Ability to influence agency program staff and political leadership through collaboration and complex relationship management.
Ability to develop and maintain a multi-year roadmap that aligns technology investment to mission priorities
Ability to manage budget and resources, and influence thinking in regards to technology investment.
Ability to set individual and team performance expectations tied to outcomes, conduct developmental performance conversations, and navigate performance issues constructively across a cross-functional team of specialists.
Ability to manage across disciplines — providing meaningful feedback and accountability to team members — without needing to be a practitioner in each craft.
Ability to quickly understand state agency planning, budget, and decision-making processes, including budget cycles, legislative constraints, and executive branch governance
Knowledge of enterprise architecture fundamentals sufficient to apply EA standards, flag exceptions, and engage meaningfully with OIT's EA function
Ability to apply modern software delivery approaches, including user centricity, agile, product ownership, modular procurement, and continuous delivery at a conceptual and operational level
Knowledge of State IT governance, procurement law, and vendor contracting in a government context.

Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions Of Employment & Appeal Rights

A wide salary range is posted for this position and any job offer is based upon a salary analysis to comply with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. The salary analysis considers relevant experience, education, certifications, and state seniority as compared to others doing substantially similar work. While all offers are compliant with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, there is no guarantee an offer will be at the top of the posted range based on the salary analysis.

Minimum Qualifications

This is a skills-based job announcement. The required minimum qualifications and/or education (if substituting for the proven experience, knowledge, and skills), are as follows:

A minimum of eight (8) years of experience as a lead in the delivery of technology solutions, to include three (3) years experience managing cross-functional teams using iterative, user-centered methods.
A track record of working across disciplines — design, engineering, policy, or operations — to ship things that work for real people.

Substitutions

Additional appropriate education will substitute for the required experience on a year-for-year basis, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.

Training or Certification related to the work assigned to the position will be assigned credit towards substitution for experience and/or education, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.

If the minimum qualifications include a degree requirement, additional appropriate paid or unpaid experience will substitute for the required education on a year-for-year basis.

Preferred Qualifications

Relevant certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Institute Product Management, PMP, or Professional Product Manager (PPM).
Experience working within a digital service agency or a government-adjacent technology firm, successfully translating mission-driven policy goals into actionable product backlogs.
Experience in modern procurement practices is highly desirable, with the ability to structure vendor requirements in a way that remains outcome-oriented and agile rather than locking the state into rigid, fixed-scope contracts
Background in User-Centered Design (UCD).

Conditions Of Employment

OIT employees must comply with any screening procedures in place at state agency locations where they might perform work.

A pre-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process. Post-employment background checks will be required for specific agencies as business needs dictate, which may include a polygraph exam, fingerprint-based criminal history search, reference checks, and a drug test.

This position may require travel within the specified geographic area, and to locations across the state as needed.

Supplemental Information

If this posting indicates “remote from anywhere in CO” in the title, periodic reporting to the primary state work location designated for the position is required. All remote work must be performed in Colorado.

While candidates from out of state will be considered for this role, the candidate selected for the position must relocate and reside in Colorado on the first day of their new position. A reasonable timeframe for relocation will be established on an individual basis, while considering business needs, and determining a start date.

new_jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Director of IT PMO leads the enterprise Project Management Office for a retail client, overseeing the governance, execution, and delivery of technology initiatives across stores, digital commerce, supply chain, merchandising, and corporate systems. This role ensures disciplined project delivery, strategic alignment with business priorities, and measurable value realization from IT investments. The Director serves as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and drives operational excellence across the technology portfolio.
Key Responsibilities

1. Portfolio Governance & Strategic Alignment

Own and manage the enterprise IT project portfolio covering POS modernization, e‑commerce, ERP, supply chain, loyalty, and store operations.
Lead annual and quarterly roadmap planning, ensuring alignment with merchandising, store operations, digital, and corporate functions.
Establish governance frameworks, approval processes, and prioritization models to ensure investments support business outcomes.

2. Delivery Excellence & Methodology Leadership

Define and enforce PMO standards, methodologies, templates, and best practices (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, hybrid).
Ensure consistent execution across all retail technology initiatives, including large‑scale store rollouts and omnichannel programs.
Drive continuous improvement, operational maturity, and delivery efficiency across the PMO.

3. Financial & Vendor Management

Manage PMO budgets, forecasting, resource planning, and financial reporting.
Oversee vendor relationships, including system integrators, SaaS providers, and retail technology partners.
Ensure cost optimization, contract compliance, and value realization from external partners.

4. Risk, Compliance & Change Management

Identify, assess, and mitigate risks related to supply chain disruptions, store system outages, and omnichannel dependencies.
Lead enterprise change management for technology impacting store associates, customers, and corporate teams.
Ensure compliance with IT policies, audit requirements, and industry standards.

5. Stakeholder & Executive Communication

Provide clear, concise, executive‑level communication on portfolio health, risks, dependencies, and business impact.
Partner closely with CIO, COO, merchandising, store operations, digital, product, engineering, and finance leaders.
Act as the voice of the PMO and a strategic advisor for technology‑enabled business transformation.

6. Leadership & Team Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of project managers, program managers, and PMO analysts.
Build a high‑performance culture focused on accountability, transparency, and delivery excellence.
Manage resource allocation across competing priorities and multi‑year initiatives.

new_jobs.title: Director, Marketing Technology & Data Operations
new_jobs.description:
We believe in the power and joy of learning

At Cengage, our employees have a direct impact in helping learners around the world discover the power and joy of learning. We are bonded by our shared purpose – driving innovation that helps millions of learners improve their lives and achieve their dreams through education.

About The Role

Cengage is looking for Director, Marketing Technology & Data Operations
to be a strategic, collaborative, and forward-thinking leader to build and scale our global Marketing Technology and Data function and team. Reporting to the VP of Marketing Operations, this role will define the vision, governance, and operating model for our marketing technology and data ecosystem, enabling marketing teams around the world to work more effectively, deliver exceptional customer experiences, and accelerate business growth.

You'll lead the strategy behind our MarTech portfolio—from roadmap planning and technology governance to vendor management, ROI evaluations, platform rationalization, AI innovation, and experimentation. Working across Marketing, Digital, IT, Procurement, Finance, RevOps, Sales, Security, and Legal, you'll help ensure our technology investments align with business priorities while creating a scalable foundation for the future.

You'll define the vision, strategy, and operating model for marketing data, building trusted, scalable data capabilities that improve decision-making, enable personalization and AI, strengthen measurement, and deliver greater business value.

As a strong people leader, you’ll lead, coach, and develop a global marketing technology and data team.

This is an opportunity for a leader and builder who enjoys solving complex business problems, influencing across organizations, and bringing structure, governance, and innovation to a growing enterprise marketing organization.

What You'll Do Here

Develop the marketing technology strategy

Define and own a marketing technology strategy and roadmap aligned to business priorities and customer experience goals.
Translate marketing and business needs into technology recommendations, investment priorities, and implementation plans.
Partner with Marketing and cross-functional teams to define the future-state MarTech ecosystem and supporting architecture.
Find opportunities to unlock new marketing capabilities, improve operational efficiency, and support business growth through technology.

Define marketing data strategy, governance & operations

Establish the vision, governance, operating model, and roadmap for marketing data to improve quality, accessibility, compliance, and business value across the global marketing organization.
Partner with Marketing, RevOps, Digital, IT, Analytics, Sales, and Data Engineering teams to align data requirements and use cases; define data platforms, standards, architecture, and integration strategies that enable personalized experiences, trusted reporting, AI, and advanced analytics.
Lead data quality, stewardship, taxonomy, and master data management initiatives to ensure consistent account, customer, campaign, and performance data across the MarTech ecosystem.
Partner with cross-functional teams evolve marketing measurement by enabling scalable attribution, performance dashboards, experimentation, and actionable insights that support business growth and executive decision-making.
Oversee marketing data operations, including data pipelines, integrations, privacy, governance, and operational processes that ensure reliable, secure, and compliant data management.
Build a future-ready data foundation and team that accelerates maturity while reducing technical debt and operational complexity.

Build governance and operational excellence

Establish governance processes for evaluating, selecting, implementing, and retiring marketing and data technologies.
Create and maintain a comprehensive inventory of marketing applications, integrations, licenses, and business owners.
Lead technology rationalization efforts to reduce redundancy, simplify the technology landscape, and increase platform adoption.
Develop standards, policies, and operating procedures that improve consistency, scalability, and decision-making.
Ensure alignment with enterprise governance processes including security, privacy, legal, procurement, architecture review, and software lifecycle management.
Balance global standardization with regional business needs to support worldwide marketing teams.

Lead technology investment and vendor management

Manage the intake, prioritization, evaluation, and recommendation process for new technology requests.
Partner with Procurement and Finance to manage contracts, licensing, renewals, and annual spend forecasting.
Build business cases and technical requirements that guide technology investment decisions.
Establish vendor performance management through scorecards, business reviews, roadmap alignment, and strategic partnerships.
Monitor platform utilization and recommend opportunities to optimize licenses, reduce costs, and improve adoption.

Drive innovation, AI, and experimentation

Develop and implement the marketing AI roadmap in partnership with enterprise AI and technology teams.
Identify, pilot, and scale AI-powered capabilities that improve marketer productivity, campaign performance, customer engagement, and operational efficiency.
Champion experimentation by enabling testing frameworks, measurement approaches, and continuous optimization across digital marketing experiences.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend innovations that position Cengage for long-term success.
Establish responsible governance for AI adoption, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and business objectives.

Partner across the business

Build trusted partnerships with leaders across Marketing, Digital, IT, Procurement, Finance, Sales, Security, and Legal, and external vendors.
Align cross-functional roadmaps, delivery timelines, and investment priorities across partner groups.
Influence strategic technology decisions through data-driven recommendations and executive communication.
Drive organizational adoption through enablement, change management, documentation, and standards.

Build and lead high-performing teams

Lead, coach, and develop a global marketing technology and data team.
Establish clear goals, development plans, and success metrics for team members.
Recruit and retain top talent while building organizational capabilities for the future.

Skills Required For This Position

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in Marketing Technology, Marketing Operations, Data Operations, Digital Marketing, Business Systems, or related areas.
Strong people leadership and coaching ability. Demonstrated success building and leading high-performing teams in complex enterprise environments.
Experience leading enterprise MarTech and data strategy, governance, technology transformation, or digital capability programs.
Strong understanding of modern marketing technology and data ecosystems, including CRM, marketing automation, web platforms, analytics, experimentation, digital asset management, customer data platforms, and AI-enabled marketing solutions.
Deep expertise in marketing data strategy, governance, and operations, with a proven ability to build trusted, scalable data foundations that enable measurement, AI, personalization, and business growth.
Experience developing technology roadmaps, governance frameworks, and portfolio management practices.
Experience evaluating technology investments, managing vendors, and leading software selection processes.
Strong business sense with the ability to translate business objectives into technology strategies and investment recommendations.
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.

Preferred

Experience developing AI strategies, piloting AI capabilities, or scaling AI adoption within marketing organizations.
Experience implementing experimentation, optimization, or personalization programs.
Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and enterprise project governance.
Experience supporting global marketing teams in B2B SaaS or EdTech organizations.
Master's degree or equivalent combination of advanced education and relevant experience.

Join us at Cengage, where your expertise will build the future of learning and help millions of learners achieve their dreams!
